head_commit.message:
chore: devbox update — align the toolchain lock (FU-022)

Weekly synchronized devbox.lock bump so shared tools resolve to the same version across repos (nix cache + agent-base bake hits).

repository.name: homelab
repository.description: Agentic software delivery on its own Talos Kubernetes platform — research shapes goals, agents ride issues to CI-verified PRs, and production closes each goal validated or reverted. Boot-from-git, no click-ops.
